name: myicon
about: Example profile for fieldkit icons build. Put a square picture (1024 px or larger) beside this file as my-picture.png, or give its full path. crop is [left, top, right, bottom] in that picture. cap_polygon (the part to recolour) and subject_polygon (kept in front of a dark background with --dark) are optional outlines, in picture pixels. One icon is made per colour.
